---
title: "Seedling diameter"
format:
  html:
    theme: coderpro
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: true
  cache: false
---

These are made-up data for eight seedlings. Each row is one seedling.
Diameter is the stem diameter in mm at the start.
This document reads the CSV and makes a plot.

```{r import}
seedlings <- read.csv("data/seedlings.csv")
head(seedlings)
```

One diameter measurement is missing. This histogram counts only the seven
recorded measurements; missing diameter is not a diameter of zero.

```{r diameter-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
hist(
  seedlings$diameter_mm,
  breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8),
  main = "Initial seedling stem diameter",
  xlab = "Stem diameter (mm)",
  ylab = "Number of seedlings",
  col = "#1b9e77",
  border = "white"
)
```

Clicking Render leaves the CSV unchanged. The HTML shows the report.
The QMD contains the text and R code needed to make it again.
